scope: Read-only audit of five imported confirmed floor regions; no confirmed geometry changed

original_source_provenance.fixture_selection: All five confirmed_review records plus every selected GT with exactly eight floor vertices from the original 280-entry catalogue; no photo data

units: camera_height_normalized_xz; h is camera height, not metres

method.gt_conversion: Same ERP floor formula as geometry.js: odd-numbered 0-based entries; camera-height-normalized x,z
method.screen_estimate: SVG viewBox pixels at initial fit and zoom=1; actual CSS/screenshot pixels and later zoom may differ
method.fit_scale_formula: max(x_extent/460, z_extent/390, 0.0001) over selected GT and confirmed polygon
method.distance: Signed perpendicular distances to exact selected GT supporting line; overlap is projection intersection with the finite GT segment
limitations: Only five confirmed_review snapshots frozen from the original data.json, not newer browser-only drafts or confirmations.
Nearness cannot establish user intent; no proposed snap is approved.
Small deviations in axis-aligned rectangles are compatible with projecting slightly non-axis-aligned ERP-rounded GT into angle=0 rectangles; no attribution beyond geometry.
Supporting-line-only matches are separated from actual finite wall-segment overlap.
Top boundaries and formal reference eligibility are outside this audit.
